title: Nidoran 029/165 Rev Holo Pokeball Pokemon 151 Scarlet & Violet Korean sv2a
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokémon card is a great addition to any collector's deck. The Nidoran card, numbered 029/165, features a reverse holo finish and is from the Scarlet & Violet set. It is a stage 1 Pokémon with the attribute of Dark and the character of Nidoran. The card is made of card stock material and is in the standard card size.

This card is perfect for fans of the Pokémon TCG and is great for those who collect cards in Korean language. It is suitable for ages 8+ and is not a vintage item. The card is manufactured by Nintendo and was made in Japan. Whether you are looking to complete your collection or just starting out, this Nidoran card is a must-have.
